newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Peralta Community College Dist.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the above Bonds will be offered for public sale by the Board of Trustees of the Peralta Community College District, County of Alameda, State of California, on

at the hour of 10:00 A.M., California time (or on such other date and time as may be determined by the Chancellor of the District as provided in the paragraph below), at the offices of Dale Scott & Company Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA 94104, subject to all of the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale describing the Bonds, copies of which (along with a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds) will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor to the District, Dale Scott & Company Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA 94104 (telephone (415) 956-1030; fax (415) 956-1322). Legal Opinion: Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP, San Francisco, California, and Lofton, De Lancie & Nelson, San Francisco, California.

Any sale date for the Bonds may be changed at the sole discretion of the Chancellor of the District by providing notice thereof through Thompson Municipal News and Bloomberg Business News at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the then-scheduled sale date of the Bonds.
Clerk of the Board of Trustees
